newsitem.title: USA: Uruguay secures $174 mln IMF stand-by credit.
newsitem.headline: Uruguay secures $174 mln IMF stand-by credit.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund approved a 21-month stand-by credit of about $174 million to support Uruguay's 1997-98 economic program.
The IMF said in a statement Friday that the government of Uruguay did not intend to draw on the stand-by credit and planned to treat it as precautionary.

Policies under the government program include the consolidation of public finances, the de-indexation of wages and prices administered by the public sector and ongoing structural reforms, the IMF said.
